acceptanceCriteria: an import-direction test enforces the tasks/Core boundary
corvint-tasks --version prints the injected build identity and the companion gate builds the in-tree package
corvint-tasks builds from cmd/corvint-tasks in this repository and passes its own test target
the 1.0 product spec says in-tree separate companion binary, per decision 0397
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 panel review addendum (Beamfall fit and corvint-tasks), scratchpad review/out/panel-addendum.md. Owner instruction 2026-09-25: 'move corvint-tasks into corvint'. Follow addendum §3: separate companion binary cmd/corvint-tasks backed by internal/tasks/**, never a corvint subcommand (invariant 7, decision 0322). Steps: measure go test time of beamfall/corvint-tasks@800682d and choose same module (preferred, lets Core import internal/tasks/wire) or nested module; import as one squash commit with a provenance note to 800682d (history not reviewed for the public lineage, decision 0331); rewrite module path github.com/Beamfall/corvint-tasks; add an import-direction test (internal/tasks/** imports no Core package; Core imports only internal/tasks/wire); inject a real corvint-tasks build version via -ldflags in companionrelease.go and the Makefile and correct the bundle README claim (M3, V1-0308); point script/corvint-companion-release-gate at the in-tree package and drop CORVINT_TASKMAN_REPO; give tasks tests their own Make target. The .taskman projection, .git/taskman journal format and wire profiles do not change.

completion.reason: Stale: every acceptance criterion is already met on origin/main (verified at a5aeee41). Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-06-stale-ticket-closure.md at 5a7045a537610b0afe2117428c8268c5d938c074 (PR beamfall/corvint#629), row V1-0317: commit fc32f8f2; AC1: internal/tasks/boundary_test.go enforces import direction with negative controls; AC2: main.build injection, versionResult and companionrelease.go wire the in-tree binary; AC3: docs/BUILD-LOG.md:6604 records tasks-test PASS and tasks-build printing +build.120; AC4: corvint-1.0-product-and-release-v1.md:88 explicitly says in-tree separate companion binary. Read-only independent verification (Codex batch B) plus mechanical check of cited commits, tests and paths; no suite rerun for this closure.

title: corvint-tasks: move the source in-tree as cmd/corvint-tasks and internal/tasks (decision 0397)
